subject.title: fix: block Cloud SDK workspace env controls [AI]

question: Should OpenClaw reserve the full project-local `CLOUDSDK_*` namespace as untrusted and accept explicit `undefined` as the shared child-environment removal operation?
rationale: The broader rule closes current and future Cloud SDK control injection, but it intentionally removes legitimate project-local Cloud SDK configuration and formalizes a shared executor contract that differs from native Node handling.

options.title: Approve the fail-closed boundary
options.body: Block the full workspace namespace, retain trusted shell/global configuration, and accept explicit `undefined` as the executor's removal sentinel.

options.title: Narrow the blocked controls
options.body: Preserve selected project-local Cloud SDK settings but replace the prefix with a security-reviewed key list and maintain coverage as Google adds controls.

recommendation.title: Approve the fail-closed boundary
recommendation.body: Block the full workspace namespace, retain trusted shell/global configuration, and accept explicit `undefined` as the executor's removal sentinel.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the existing Cloud SDK workspace and Gmail subprocess security boundary that this PR completes.
